raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be in stock"
      role subject ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?x
      role object "a 48-port PoE switch"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
